Volume I is the active textbook foundation for AffineDrift control theory.
It is published from the current manuscript material in `articles/textbook/` and the chapterized Quarto workspace in `articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/`.

[Open Chapterized Hub](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/index.html){.resource-link}
[Open Consolidated Manuscript](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/textbook-main.html){.resource-link}
[Open LaTeX PDF Snapshot](../articles/textbook/main.pdf){.resource-link}
[View Source Manuscript (.tex)](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/articles/textbook/main.tex){.resource-link}

## Scientific Status

This volume is a living technical manuscript for research and engineering workflows.
It is not presented as peer-reviewed consensus material; readers should treat claims as working hypotheses unless externally verified.

## Source Traceability

- Primary manuscript source: `articles/textbook/`
- Chapter source files: `articles/textbook/chapters/ch0*_*.tex`
- Website chapter mirror: `articles/tangent-hyperplane-contraction/chapters/*.qmd`

## Notebook Workflow

The notebooks feature provides executable chapter companions for derivations, simulations, and figure regeneration.
Use the bridge under `notebooks/geometry_of_motion/` to map each notebook run to the corresponding chapter source and output artifacts.
